title: Custom Avast trampoline publish gate
contracts: The Avast compatibility path owns one generated executable trampoline for ntdll NtDeviceIoControlFile
Generated executable bytes are written through a local unpublished pointer
The generated code range is flushed before publication through static code or returned Address
Allocation failure returns the native lookup status without writing through a null trampoline pointer
This SREV does not change hook selection LdrGetProcedureAddress forwarding target API name matching or generated x86 x64 trampoline bytes
runtime_gate: Windows x86/x64 Avast/SnxHk compatibility smoke proving the generated NtDeviceIoControlFile trampoline is returned and callable
